entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I... I think I need to return my VeloBand. I'm just not sure what to do.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your full name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... uh... VF789012.
Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker right here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know if it's broken... it's just so confusing. I really expected more, you know? The screen is just... hard to use. I even read the whole user manual, but it didn't help. Can't you just help me?
I understand it can be frustrating when a new device doesn't feel intuitive right away. I see you received it 41 days ago. Let me just take a moment to review our return policy for you.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.

Alright, I've checked the policy. And good news, it looks like all our items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're unfortunately outside that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you so much!

You're very welcome, Maria. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Simply print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll see the refund processed within 3-5 business days after we receive the item.
That's perfect. That's everything I needed. Thank you again, Isaac.
It was my pleasure to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
